answer: The rule is simple: only a lived past opens the door. Beekeeper association membership with apiary inspection attestation enforces it through membership needs inspected hives and annual honey harvest records, so a hundred. The opal is the anchor in the physical world — something a script cannot conjure and a verifier can test without trusting the claimant. A farm must reproduce that anchor a hundred times, and the quartz in each copy is the cost of the real thing, paid in money and in years. The thread is the test result.
